title: Decision tree depth under coordinate embedding
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $e:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be an injection, and let $f:\mathbb F_2^m\to\alpha$. Define a function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ by reading the coordinates indexed by $e$ and applying $f$. Its decision tree depth equals the decision tree depth of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: injection e from the m coordinates to the n coordinates
function f from ℱ₂^m to α
